liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet into Fire is played with a lot of energy [14]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Jam and outro are the standouts, with Bobby slinging chords high up the neck [14]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Drums segment the most interesting part of the show [9]
- **Women are Smarter** (1 review): Reviewer says this was the first Women Are Smarter [12]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Man Smart (Woman Smarter) [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-07-02.152647.nak300.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the sound of this audience recording as crystal clear [15]
- **gd1981-07-02.175898.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: audience recording; 25 songs; 171 min [2]. Said about its sound: Taper's microphone placement was centered and up front, though the mics are not recalled; A 30-second dropout in the right channel of Friend of the Devil was repaired by channel mixing [2]
- **gd81-07-02.senn421.munder.9828.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 158 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [4]
- **gd1981-07-02.134522.s2.aud.schley.flac2448**: audience recording; 13 songs; 96 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Updated transfer is a major improvement, and the recording captures every instrument [12]
- **gd1981-07-02.134521.s2.aud.schley.flac1644**: audience recording; 13 songs; 96 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience tape's quality and vibe put the listener right in the action [14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer had a spare ticket on his mother's 56th birthday, and went alone after others declined [8]
- On the way into town, reviewer stopped at his friend Steve's apartment before the show [8]
- Reviewer wonders whether Garcia could hear himself on stage [9]
- Reviewer's first show: he came off a Gulf crewboat headed for New Orleans and flew to Houston instead [11]
- A cab dropped him at a cheap hotel beside the Summit; a ticket cost about $7 [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-07-02.152647.nak300.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII) [1]. Also: A 1:42 patch in Alabama Getaway comes from an unknown audience source shared by Jon Bernstein; An unknown audience source from Brian Schley's group supplies the Scarlet crowd opening, a transition patch, and all of US Blues [1]
- **gd1981-07-02.175898.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: taped by Master Cassettes Recorded by Jon Bernstein; transferred by Transfer, Mastering by Ray Ackerman Edited, Processed w/ add'l Mastering by Joe Noel December 13, 2025; source: ?? mics > ?? lead deck > ?? deck > Master Cassettes [2]
- **gd81-07-02.senn421.munder.9828.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [4]. Also: This source lacks the US Blues encore [4]
- **gd1981-07-02.134522.s2.aud.schley.flac2448**: taped by Brian Schley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: 2nd Set AUD: Unknown Mics > lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Hitachi ME Metal tape, FOB recording by Brian Schley. [5]. Also: Jon Bernstein's audience tape patches the tape flip in Eyes of the World, from 6:55 to 7:19; Bernstein's audience tape also supplies the complete encore track [5]
- **gd1981-07-02.134521.s2.aud.schley.flac1644**: taped by Brian Schley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: 2nd Set AUD: Unknown Mics > lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Hitachi ME Metal tape, FOB recording by Brian Schley. [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by John Rottet Grateful Dead: [1981-07-02 The Summit, Houston, TX, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1981-07-02-the-summit-houston-tx-usa/) [17]
